summary.text: Sue Salisbury (listed by Ballotpedia as Suzanne Salisbury) is a Democratic state representative who has represented Maine House District 128 since December 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a business owner who founded Westbrook Families Feeding Families.

paragraphs.text: Salisbury earned an A.A. in social work from the University of Maine at Augusta in 2002 and a B.A. in leadership from the University of Southern Maine in 2022.
Her career experience includes owning The Daily Grind, and she founded Westbrook Families Feeding Families.
Salisbury took office in the Maine House on December 6, 2022.
Ballotpedia lists her as chair of both the Ethics Committee and the Criminal Justice and Public Safety Committee for 2023-2024.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
